description: Print one callable's direct callers and callees, resolved against a project and its Nx dependencies.

addresses.description: The callables to look up, each as <file>#<qualified-name>. Every one must resolve, or the run prints nothing.

configurationPath.description: Path to the callidescope configuration file, relative to the workspace root.

format.description: What to print: markdown, mermaid, or json.

projects.description: Nx project names to resolve the address against, replacing the project this target belongs to.

tags.description: Nx project tags to resolve the address against, selecting every project carrying ANY of them.

withDependencies.description: Widen the selection along the Nx dependency graph, so a call stack is not truncated at a project boundary.

title: Callidescope breadth
